ProjectService is the installation's projects (spin#720): a repository and the shape of the. workspace that opens it (CreateWorkspaceRequest.project_id). Anybody signed in makes one where. the installation lets everybody (the setting project_creation), and is its first admin. A project is seen by everybody while it is shared with everyone, and otherwise by its admins and. whom it is shared with; the instance's admins see and administer every one. Whoever sees one. opens workspaces from it, in a team of theirs.

| Field | Type | What it is |

| `description` | string |  |
| `repository` | string |  |
| `ref` | string |  |
| `image` | string |  |
| `preset` | string |  |

## GetProjectCosts

`POST /spin.v1.ProjectService/GetProjectCosts`

What a project cost in the month in progress, to its admins and nobody else, as ListProjectWorkspaces: everybody's workspaces of it summed, its prebuilds' builds included, and a month of what its prebuilds keep. A sum, never by workspace: one workspace's cost says how much its owner works, which a project's admin who is not their team's is not told. Read from the bill as the installation last read it, never from the cloud.

**Request**

| Field | Type | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `projectId` | string |  |

**Response**

| Field | Type | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `month` | `Timestamp` | The month in progress: its first instant, UTC. |
| `readAt` | `Timestamp` | When the bill was last read; unset where it never was - an installation with no bill scope - and then nothing below is known and nothing is to be drawn. |
| `currency` | string | ISO 4217; every amount here is in millionths of it. |
| `workspaces` | [CostShare](/reference/api/types/#costshare) | Its workspaces' shares summed, deleted ones and its prebuilds' builds included: a workspace is the project's it opened, whoever's it was. |
| `prebuilds` | [PrebuildsKept](/reference/api/types/#prebuildskept) |  |

## ListPrebuilds

`POST /spin.v1.ProjectService/ListPrebuilds`

A project's prebuilds, to whoever sees it; and a build of one of its refs now, by its admins, rather than at the next look.

**Request**

| Field | Type | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `projectId` | string |  |

**Response**

| Field | Type | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `prebuilds` | list of [Prebuild](/reference/api/types/#prebuild) | Newest first. |
| `storageMeasuredAt` | `Timestamp` | When storage-gc last read the store, which each stored_bytes is as of; unset before it has. |
| `retireUnusedDays` | integer (int32) | The installation's prebuild_retire_unused_days: a ready prebuild nobody opened a workspace from in this many days is retired, its ref's newest included. Zero retires none for that. |
| `refsNotFound` | list of [PrebuildRefNotFound](/reference/api/types/#prebuildrefnotfound) | The refs the project prebuilds that its forge says the repository has not - a branch deleted since it was named - as the prebuilds job last found them: nothing is built of one until the forge has it again or the project names it no longer. |

## ListProjectWorkspaces

`POST /spin.v1.ProjectService/ListProjectWorkspaces`

Everybody's workspaces open on a project, to its admins and nobody else: a person it is only shared with is refused, and reads their own with ListWorkspaces.

**Request**

| Field | Type | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `projectId` | string |  |

**Response**

| Field | Type | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `workspaces` | list of [ProjectWorkspace](/reference/api/types/#projectworkspace) | Newest first, and at most 500. Not a prebuild's build, and not a deleted one. |
